method: Complete 0.5-second visual review of 4800-4860; additional 0.125-second review of 4800-4808. Assistant-reviewed, not independently verified by a human coach. The unresolved 4800-4804 interval remains pending and is NOT declared negative or removed from the preregistered cohort.
definition: Visible live-ball field-goal attempts including blocked attempts; free throws excluded. Reviewed duration includes ordinary in-game dead balls and free-throw preparation, not exclusively live-ball time.
split: expansion frozen before any algorithm run on this time range; same game as previous splits, NOT a new-game holdout
